newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom puts phone directories on Internet.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom puts phone directories on Internet.

text.p: France Telecom said it has made its various telephone directories available on the Internet.
Initially only customers of France Telecom's own Internet service provider, Wanadoo, will be able to access the directories.
But by summer all 600,000 Internet users in France and 50 million worldwide will have access to them, Gerard Eymery, director of France Telecom Multimedia, told a news conference.
An English-language version of the directories is also planned.
The directories cover "Yellow Pages", the directory by trade or profession, the standard directory by name and address and a directory of companies.
There is also the possibility of searching by theme and a function which obtains names, addresses and phone numbers of all commercial outlets on a given road.
Internet use has come slowly to France, partly because of the high penetration of France Telecom's teletext service Minitel, which gives cheap access to basic information.
Earlier this month France Telecom said it was launching a service allowing Minitel users to use email on the Internet. WEM/SLA
